en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Talha Bin Zayd, (It has been narrated) from Abu Adullah Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>
having said that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘I gave a boy to my maternal aunt and forbade her that she should make him a butcher, or a cupper, or a goldsmith’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd who has said the following: “This is a narration of abu ‘Abd Allah, Ja’far ibn Muhammad, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, from the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.
He (the Messenger of Allah) has said, ‘I gave a boy to my aunt and prohibited her from making him a butcher, cupping person or a jewelry carver.’”
